text:
sara_cs: Heads-up — I'm putting together a short customer-facing 72h activation checklist that focuses on caching, batching, and streaming recommendations for mid-market accounts. Want a quick sync before we publish to the tenant portal.

mike_se: Love it. Can you call out exact config knobs we recommend (batch size, TTLs, streaming window)? customers ask for numbers, not just concepts.

liz_csm: +1. Also need a small troubleshooting section: what to check if latency spikes after go-live. Keep language non-technical for PMs, but include an "if you see X check Y" mapping.

sara_cs: Good call. Draft outline: 1) First 24h: pre-seed cache & prefetch patterns 2) 24–72h: adaptive batching + monitoring 3) Fallbacks & renewal risk signals. Will include sample requests and what success looks like.

mike_se: For numbers: recommend initial batch_size = 8 for text-gen endpoints, aggressive TTL = 30s for high-turnover prompts, and a conservative KV cache size per-tenant. Also suggest `max_concurrency=16` for dedicated capacity customers.

olga_pm: Can we add a one-line blurb about cost tradeoffs? Customers care if caching increases token usage elsewhere.

sara_cs: Yes: add a simple dos-and-don'ts section. e.g., "Do prefill low-variance prompts; Don't cache personalized sensitive tokens".

tariq_cust: From the field — call out onboarding checklist item: capture avg request length and peak QPS in first 6 hours. Those signals inform quantization / model choices later.

liz_csm: Also include a short feedback capture template we can send after 72h: 3 quick questions + ask for 2 example requests that failed or had low quality.

onboard-bot: Reminder: attach the security-approved phrasing for private deployments (link: https://redwood.internal/policies/priv-deploy).

mike_se: Tiny technical note for eng: if you rely on prefix caching, recommend `cache_key_v2` that includes prompt fingerprint + stable user id. That avoids accidental collisions.

sara_cs: Drafting a short example snippet for customers — we can show a curl to pre-seed a cache. Example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"tenant":"acme","prompts":["welcome flow v1"]}'
```

liz_csm: Keep the snippet optional for non-tech users. Put it under "Advanced" collapse on the portal page.

tariq_cust: Renewal-risk signal idea: if week-over-week active user count drops by >20% and error-rate >1% for top 10 prompts -> auto-escalate to CSM. Add clear play action: open support ticket, schedule handshake call, enable temporary burst capacity.

olga_pm: Can we add a reusable checklist card for the onboarding engineer? e.g., checkbox list: collect telemetry, prefill cache, enable streaming, validate fallbacks, send feedback form.

mike_se: For streaming: recommend `stream_chunk_ms=150` for conversational UIs; set client-side read timeout to 45s to avoid mid-stream disconnects.

sara_cs: Perfect. I'll stitch into a single one-page checklist + a short expanded FAQ. Plan: share draft in this thread by EOD, then tag `#customer-portal` for publishing if no objections.

liz_csm: Small language nit: replace "TTL" with "cache TTL (how long answers are reused)" for non-technical readers.

sara_cs: Noted. Thanks all — expect draft in ~3 hours. If anyone has a short customer quote about what they'd like to see, drop it here and I'll include as an example.
